book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: كنا عيلة فقيرة، من نوع الفقرا اللي بيخبوا فقرهم.
sentences.en: We were a poor family, the kind of poor who hide their poverty.

sentences.ar: أبوي موظف، وأمي بتحسب، وأختاي بانتظار عريس ما بيجي.
sentences.en: My father a clerk, my mother counting, my two sisters waiting for suitors who did not come.

sentences.ar: وكل أحد، كنا نلبس أحسن تيابنا، ونمشي على الرصيف عند البحر.
sentences.en: And every Sunday, we put on our best clothes, and walked along the pier by the sea.

sentences.ar: وأبوي يتطلع بالسفن الجاية، ويقول نفس الجملة:
sentences.en: And my father would look at the ships coming in, and say the same sentence:

sentences.ar: لو كان جول بهالسفينة، شو كانت مفاجأة!
sentences.en: If Jules were on that ship, what a surprise!

sentences.ar: جول أخوه.
sentences.en: Jules, his brother.

sentences.ar: والأمل الوحيد للعيلة.
sentences.en: And the family's only hope.

sentences.ar: عمي جول كان بشبابه مصيبة.
sentences.en: My uncle Jules had been a disaster in his youth.

sentences.ar: صرف ورثه، وصرف جزء من ورث أبوي، وعمل فضايح.
sentences.en: He spent his inheritance, spent part of my father's, and made scandals.

sentences.ar: فبعتوه على أمريكا، زي ما بيعملوا بهيك ناس.
sentences.en: So they sent him to America, as is done with such people.

sentences.ar: وبعد سنتين، إجا مكتوب: أنا بشتغل، وبربح، ورح أعوضكم عن كل شي.
sentences.en: And after two years, a letter came: I am working, and earning, and I will repay you for everything.

sentences.ar: وبعد سنتين كمان، مكتوب تاني: رح أسافر لأمريكا الجنوبية بتجارة كبيرة.
sentences.en: And two years later, a second letter: I am leaving for South America on a big venture.

sentences.ar: ما تستنوا مكاتيب.
sentences.en: Expect no letters.

sentences.ar: وبرجع غني.
sentences.en: And I come back rich.

sentences.ar: وهاد المكتوب صار إنجيل العيلة.
sentences.en: And this letter became the family's gospel.

sentences.ar: أمي بتقراه للضيوف.
sentences.en: My mother read it to guests.

sentences.ar: وأبوي بيحفظه.
sentences.en: My father knew it by heart.

sentences.ar: وأختي الكبيرة لقت عريس بسببه.
sentences.en: And my elder sister found a husband because of it.

sentences.ar: موظف، تردد، وبعدين شاف المكتوب، وقرر.
sentences.en: A clerk, who hesitated, and then saw the letter, and decided.

sentences.ar: وبعد العرس، قررت العيلة تعمل رحلة.
sentences.en: And after the wedding, the family decided on an outing.

sentences.ar: لجزيرة جيرزي، بالباخرة.
sentences.en: To the island of Jersey, by steamer.

sentences.ar: أول سفر بحياتنا.
sentences.en: The first journey of our lives.

sentences.ar: وعالباخرة، أبوي شاف رجل عجوز بيفتح محار للسياح، وسيدتين بياكلوا.
sentences.en: And on the steamer, my father saw an old man opening oysters for the tourists, and two ladies eating.

sentences.ar: وعجبته الفكرة، وقال لأمي: نعزم البنات على محار؟
sentences.en: And the idea pleased him, and he said to my mother: shall we treat the girls to oysters?

sentences.ar: أمي ترددت، بسبب المصاري، بس الأولاد تانيين بياكلوا، وإحنا مش أقل.
sentences.en: My mother hesitated, over the money, but the other children were eating, and we were no less.

sentences.ar: وراح أبوي، ووقف عند العجوز، وتطلع فيه.
sentences.en: And my father went, stood by the old man, and looked at him.

sentences.ar: ورجع، ووجهه أصفر، وقال لأمي بصوت واطي: غريب.
sentences.en: And came back, his face pale, and said to my mother in a low voice: strange.

sentences.ar: الرجل اللي بيفتح المحار بيشبه جول.
sentences.en: The man opening the oysters looks like Jules.

sentences.ar: قالت أمي: مجنون.
sentences.en: My mother said: you are mad.

sentences.ar: قال أبوي: روحي شوفي بنفسك.
sentences.en: My father said: go and see for yourself.

sentences.ar: وراحت، ورجعت، وهي بترجف.
sentences.en: And she went, and came back, shaking.

sentences.ar: قالت: هو.
sentences.en: She said: it is him.

sentences.ar: أكيد هو.
sentences.en: Certainly him.

sentences.ar: روح اسأل الكابتن.
sentences.en: Go and ask the captain.

sentences.ar: بس لا يعرف حدا.
sentences.en: But let no one know.

sentences.ar: وراح أبوي للكابتن، ولف حول الموضوع، وسأله عن العجوز.
sentences.en: And my father went to the captain, circled the subject, and asked him about the old man.

sentences.ar: قال الكابتن: فرنسي عجوز، لقيته بأمريكا، مفلس، وأخدته بالباخرة عشان يشتغل.
sentences.en: The captain said: an old Frenchman, I found him in America, penniless, and took him on the boat to work.

sentences.ar: اسمه جول.
sentences.en: His name is Jules.

sentences.ar: جول دارمانش.
sentences.en: Jules Darmanche.

sentences.ar: وبيقولوا إنه عنده عيلة بفرنسا، بس ما بده يرجع لهم، لأنه مديون لهم.
sentences.en: And they say he has family in France, but does not want to go back to them, because he owes them.

sentences.ar: ورجع أبوي، وقعد جنب أمي، وما قدر يحكي.
sentences.en: And my father came back, sat beside my mother, and could not speak.

sentences.ar: وأمي قالت، بصوت بيرجف من الغضب: خلص.
sentences.en: And my mother said, in a voice shaking with anger: enough.

sentences.ar: صار متسول، وأكيد بده يرجع علينا.
sentences.en: He is a beggar now, and will surely come back on us.

sentences.ar: ابعد عنه.
sentences.en: Keep away from him.

sentences.ar: وعطتني مصاري، وقالت: روح ادفع للمحار، ولا تحكي معه.
sentences.en: And she gave me money, and said: go and pay for the oysters, and do not speak to him.

sentences.ar: ورحت، ووقفت قدام عمي جول.
sentences.en: And I went, and stood before my uncle Jules.

sentences.ar: عجوز، وإيديه مجعدة ومشققة، ووجهه تعبان وحزين.
sentences.en: Old, his hands wrinkled and cracked, his face tired and sad.

sentences.ar: وأعطيته المصاري، وقال: الله يخليك يا سيدي الشاب.
sentences.en: And I gave him the money, and he said: God keep you, young sir.

sentences.ar: وأعطيته بقشيش، نص فرنك، من جيبي.
sentences.en: And I gave him a tip, half a franc, from my own pocket.

sentences.ar: وتطلع فيّ، وقال: الله يخليك.
sentences.en: And he looked at me, and said: God keep you.

sentences.ar: ورجعت لأهلي، وأمي سألت: كم دفعت؟
sentences.en: And I went back to my family, and my mother asked: how much did you pay?

sentences.ar: قلت: فرنكين ونص.
sentences.en: I said: two and a half francs.

sentences.ar: صرخت: فرنكين ونص؟
sentences.en: She cried: two and a half francs?

sentences.ar: على محار؟
sentences.en: On oysters?

sentences.ar: وقلت: أعطيته نص فرنك بقشيش.
sentences.en: And I said: I gave him half a franc as a tip.

sentences.ar: وقالت: لهالمتسول؟
sentences.en: And she said: to that beggar?

sentences.ar: وأبوي أشر لها بعينه على أختي وزوجها، وسكتت.
sentences.en: And my father motioned to her with his eyes toward my sister and her husband, and she was silent.

sentences.ar: وبالرجعة، أخدنا باخرة تانية، عشان ما نشوفه.
sentences.en: And on the way back, we took another steamer, so as not to see him.

sentences.ar: وما شفت عمي جول بعدها أبداً.
sentences.en: And I never saw my uncle Jules again.

sentences.ar: وعشان هيك، أنا بعطي كل متسول بشوفه خمس فرنكات.
sentences.en: And that is why I give every beggar I see five francs.
